run_Designer_sequence_design: run the Designer class to design protein sequences using ESM language model and structure prediction
run_calc_sequence_loss: run calc_sequence_loss to compute masked language model pseudo log-likelihood loss for protein sequences
run_calc_structure_loss: run calc_structure_loss to compute cross-entropy loss between predicted and target protein structure coordinates
run_calc_total_loss: run calc_total_loss to aggregate weighted sequence structure and ngram losses for protein design optimization
run_init_schedulers: run init_schedulers to create and register learning rate schedulers for protein design optimization stages
